name: tab-reaper
title: Tab Reaper
description: Automatically close browser tabs you haven't looked at in a while
author: Keyruu

commands.name: reap-stale-tabs
commands.title: Reap Stale Tabs
commands.subtitle: Tab Reaper
commands.description: Close tabs that were last used more than the configured age ago. Runs automatically in the background.

commands.name: close-other-tabs
commands.title: Close Other Tabs
commands.subtitle: Tab Reaper
commands.description: Close every tab except the active, pinned, and audio playing ones. Asks which browser when more than one has tabs to close.

preferences.name: maxAgeMinutes
preferences.title: Max Age (minutes)
preferences.description: Tabs last used longer ago than this many minutes are closed
